title: pcdreg 0.1.0
text: First release. pcdreg() fits semiparametric proportional rate model panel count data time-varying covariates, using EM algorithm Sun et al. (2024). pcdreg(model = "mean") fits proportional means model estimating equation Hu, Sun Wei (2003). comparator used application Sun et al. (2024), included two model families can compared data. Note two reparametrisations covariates vary time, fitted mean function constrained increase. Covariance estimation rate model follows paper directly. vcov() supports type = "robust" (sandwich estimator, consistent without Poisson assumption), type = "information" (efficient information estimator), type = "profile" (Murphy–van der Vaart profile likelihood estimator, computed requested via pcdreg(profile = TRUE)). means model likelihood, sandwich estimator available . Model specification uses pcd() left hand side formula, following Surv() convention: pcd(id, time, count) examination-time rows pcd(id, tstart, tstop, count) counting-process rows carrying time-varying covariates. fitters return object inheriting "pcdfit", coef(), vcov(), confint(), summary(), baseline(), predict() plot() work way either.
